name: search_offers
title: Search rental offers
description: Use when looking for available cars and full prices in Poland. Supply the whole trip when changing criteria; omitted options reset. Filters and sort are not remembered: repeat them on every page. Do not use for an existing reservation. Examples: {"pickup":{"query":"Kraków"},"pickup_at":"2026-12-01T10:00:00+01:00","return_at":"2026-12-08T10:00:00+01:00","sort":"price"}; {"search_id":"from_previous_result","offset":8,"sort":"price"}.

query.description: A place name or address, e.g. Kraków or Warsaw Chopin Airport.
query.title: Query

city_id.description: A city_id returned by get_city_prices or a clarification; for a city name use query.
city_id.title: City Id

name: get_offer
title: Read an offer and its conditions
description: Use after search_offers to read current pricing, deposit, extras and rental policies. Supplied options are applied on top of the search selections; omitted options keep the search values. Options from earlier get_offer calls are not remembered: resend every option you changed. detail "full" adds every photo; "policies" keeps the policies in a concise response. Do not use to book or confirm a reservation. Example: {"search_id":"from_search","offer_ref":"from_offer"}.

name: get_city_prices
title: Read indicative city prices
description: Use for cached price examples before travel dates are chosen. These are dated examples, not live availability. Do not use for a binding quote. Examples: {"city":"Kraków"}; {"city":"wroclaw-krzyki","market":"en-pl"}.

name: find_pickup_points
title: Find nearby pickup points
description: Use to find physical pickup desks near a city or location. Reads the shared public snapshot. Do not treat a pickup point as a guarantee of car availability. Examples: {"city":"krakow","radius_m":10000}; {"near":{"lat":50.06,"lng":19.94},"limit":5}.

name: create_checkout
title: Prepare a checkout
description: Use after get_offer when the user chose an offer: freezes the final price, deposit, options and policies and returns checkout_id and a beep.rent link (continue_url) where the user can finish. Resend every option you applied in get_offer. Does not book anything. Show the user the price, the deposit and the cancellation policy before calling this tool. Example: {"search_id":"from_search","offer_ref":"from_offer","options":{"damage_waiver":true}}.

name: get_reservation_status
title: Read a reservation's status
description: Use to check whether a reservation is confirmed, awaits the user's code or payment, or awaits the rental company. Identify it with the e-mail used for booking, or by its number alone when the user's BEEP.rent account is connected. Never say a reservation is confirmed unless this returns status confirmed. Examples: {"reservation_number":"AB12CD34","email":"anna@example.com"}; {"reservation_number":"AB12CD34"}.

name: list_my_reservations
title: List my reservations
description: Use when the user asks about their own BEEP.rent bookings. Lists the reservations of the BEEP.rent account the user connected: upcoming ones with the next pickup first, or with include_past the last 365 days, newest first. Each has its number, status, dates, pickup place, car and total. Example: {"limit": 5}.

include_past.description: Also list rentals that ended or were cancelled in the last 365 days.
include_past.title: Include Past

name: cancel_reservation
title: Cancel a reservation
description: Use when the user asks to cancel a reservation; needs the user's BEEP.rent account connected. First call without confirm: it returns the refund and a confirmation_token and cancels nothing. Show the refund, get the user's explicit yes, then call again with confirm=true and that token. Cancellation is irreversible. Example: {"reservation_number":"AB12CD34","confirm":true,"confirmation_token":"from_preview"}.

reservation_number.description: The number of one of the user's own reservations.
reservation_number.title: Reservation Number

confirm.description: false previews; true executes the previewed operation.
confirm.title: Confirm

name: quote_extension
title: Price a longer rental
description: Use when the user wants to return the car later; needs the user's BEEP.rent account connected: prices the extra days. Only a rental in progress can be extended. Changes nothing. Example: {"reservation_number":"AB12CD34","new_return_at":"2026-12-10T10:00:00+01:00"}.

reservation_number.description: The number of one of the user's own reservations.
reservation_number.title: Reservation Number

name: request_extension
title: Request a rental extension
description: Use after quote_extension when the user asked to extend. First call without confirm previews the request and returns confirmation_token; after the user's explicit yes call again with confirm=true, the token and the same new_return_at. The rental company decides; decision says how the user hears back. Example: {"reservation_number":"AB12CD34","new_return_at":"2026-12-10T10:00:00+01:00","confirm":true,"confirmation_token":"from_preview"}.

reservation_number.description: The number of one of the user's own reservations.
reservation_number.title: Reservation Number

confirm.description: false previews; true executes the previewed operation.
confirm.title: Confirm
